S5_corridor.claim: If the fading coupling (b ~ 0.05) is carried by a decay-produced sterile neutrino, its mass lies in 16-20 keV (Lyman-alpha edge 15.2-17.4 keV by mean or rms free-streaming match; clock cap above), with a heavy singlet m_S ~ 3-10 TeV, Higgs portal ~1e-6 and vev 1-3 TeV.  A decay line, if visible, sits at 8-10 keV and its rest-frame centroid drifts with source redshift by -0.7 to -0.9 percent (c < 0) or +0.75 to +0.94 percent (c > 0) at z = 0.5.
S5_corridor.falsified_if: a robust thermal-equivalent WDM bound above about 7 keV (which pushes the edge past 20 keV and closes the corridor), or a detected 8-10 keV dark-matter line whose centroid shows no redshift drift at the stated level
S5_corridor.not_falsified_by: the absence of a line: the mixing angle is free in this production mode
S5_corridor.scored_by: X-ray line searches at 8-10 keV (XRISM, NuSTAR, Athena) and Lyman-alpha/half-mode WDM bounds
